name: ARGO GRAPHICS Inc.
summary: ARGO GRAPHICS Inc. provides technical solutions in Japan. The company provides PLM solutions that simulates the feasibility of all elements relating to product development; HPC solutions to process technical calculations through system design/construction utilizing; parallelization technology and optimization technology, and IT infrastructure. It also provides a range of services to support its clients, including consulting for improving operations; system development for process construction; system realization/construction; and training/operational support.
